title: seutera palustris
intro: Seutera palustris, commonly known as Swamp St. John's Wort, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to calm the nervous system and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Seutera palustris include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, diterpenoids, and phenolic acids. The plant's bioactive compounds have also shown potential in protecting against oxidative stress and inflammation, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
